{{Quote| I want music. Dance music. I want it to sound like a jungle full of passion. Woodwinds and drums.|[[Voort saBinring]] to [[Unidentified Kuratooine band]]|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Torrid Yavin''''' was a piece of backbeat-driven dance mix that was popular on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] a few years after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It was mostly used as an anthem during the rebuilding of the world.<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]], [[Wraith Squadron]] member [[Voort saBinring]] paid a [[Unidentified Kuratooine band|band]] to play a loud dance music to attract a crowd during a mission. The band played a ragged but spirited version of Torrid Yavin.<ref name="MK" />
